name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_description: ₹6,000 per year directly transferred to bank account in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000
official_text: The Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector scheme to provide income support to all landholding farmers' families in the country to supplement their financial needs for procuring various inputs related to agriculture and allied activities as well as domestic needs.
simplified_text: If you or your family owns cultivable farm land, the government sends ₹2,000 directly to your bank account every four months (total ₹6,000 each year) to help buy seeds, fertilizers, or cover family expenses.

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card
documents_required.photo_hint: Front side showing clear 12-digit number and full name

documents_required.name: Land Ownership Record (Khatauni / Patta)
documents_required.photo_hint: Official revenue document showing your name as landholder

documents_required.name: Bank Passbook or Cancelled Cheque
documents_required.photo_hint: First page showing account number and IFSC code clearly
documents_required.plain_reason: Ensures the ₹2,000 installment reaches your active account

physical_office: Gram Panchayat or Common Service Centre (CSC) in your village

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit_description: Cashless hospitalization health cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year
official_text: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest government-funded healthcare assurance scheme offering secondary and tertiary care hospitalization coverage of up to INR 5 Lakh per eligible beneficiary family per annum across empaneled public and private health facilities.
simplified_text: Free treatment and hospital stay up to ₹5 Lakh every year for your entire family across participating hospitals. You do not have to pay cash up front for covered surgeries and illnesses.

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card
documents_required.photo_hint: Original card with clear QR code
documents_required.plain_reason: Links biometric profile to health registry

documents_required.name: Ration Card or SECC Family ID
documents_required.photo_hint: Ration card showing list of all family members
documents_required.plain_reason: Confirms household eligibility under deprivation criteria

physical_office: Ayushman Mitra desk at your nearest District Hospital or CSC

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
benefit_description: Grant of ₹1.20 Lakh to ₹1.30 Lakh for building a pucca house with toilet facility
official_text: PMAY-G aims to provide financial assistance to rural BPL, homeless, or kutcha house dweller households for construction of a pucca house with basic amenities including piped water, clean cooking gas, and sanitation.
simplified_text: If you live in a village without a solid cement house, the government provides money directly in stages into your bank account (around ₹1.20 to ₹1.30 Lakh) so you can construct a safe brick home.

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card
documents_required.photo_hint: Clear front and back image

documents_required.name: Bank Account Details (DBT enabled)
documents_required.photo_hint: Bank passbook page with Aadhaar seed stamp
documents_required.plain_reason: Construction funds are credited directly in 3 installments

documents_required.name: MGNREGA Job Card (if registered)
documents_required.photo_hint: Current job card showing active registration
documents_required.plain_reason: Provides 90-95 days of additional construction labor wages

documents_required.name: Photograph of current Kutcha house
documents_required.photo_hint: Photo of beneficiary standing in front of current dwelling

physical_office: Gram Sevak or Village Panchayat Secretary office

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
benefit_description: High government interest savings account (8.2% p.a.) with full tax exemption for a girl child's education and future
official_text: The Sukanya Samriddhi Account is a government-backed savings initiative launched under the Beti Bachao, Beti Padhao campaign targeting parents of girl children to secure funds for higher education and marriage.
simplified_text: A special government savings scheme for girl children below age 10. You can deposit small amounts (from ₹250 a year) and get the highest safe government interest rate to pay for her higher studies later.

documents_required.name: Girl Child Birth Certificate
documents_required.photo_hint: Official municipal or panchayat birth certificate showing date of birth
documents_required.plain_reason: Proves girl child is below 10 years of age

documents_required.name: Parent/Guardian Aadhaar Card
documents_required.photo_hint: Aadhaar of father or mother

documents_required.name: Initial Deposit Slip (min ₹250)
documents_required.photo_hint: Cash or cheque pay-in slip
documents_required.plain_reason: Activates the post office or bank account

physical_office: Nearest India Post Office branch or authorized nationalized bank

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit_description: Collateral-free working capital micro-credit starting at ₹10,000 up to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy
official_text: PM SVANidhi is a special micro-credit facility for street vendors in urban and peri-urban areas providing collateral-free loans with cashback on digital transactions and interest subsidy on timely repayment.
simplified_text: If you sell fruits, vegetables, tea, snacks, or wares on a cart or footpath in a town or city, you can get a loan of ₹10,000 to ₹50,000 without giving any mortgage or property papers, to help restart or grow your business.

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card
documents_required.photo_hint: Linked with active mobile number

documents_required.name: Vending Certificate / Urban Local Body ID
documents_required.photo_hint: Letter of recommendation from town municipal council or ID card
documents_required.plain_reason: Confirms you are an active street vendor

physical_office: Local Municipal Corporation office or partner Bank branch

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_description: Free skill training, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, and collateral-free loans up to ₹3,00,000 at concessional 5% interest
official_text: PM Vishwakarma offers end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 designated trades, including financial credit, skill upgrading, toolkit vouchers, and market linkages.
simplified_text: For traditional craftspeople and artisans (like carpenters, blacksmiths, tailors, potters, cobblers, weavers, barbers). You get certified training, a ₹15,000 kit voucher for modern tools, and low-interest business loans.

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card
documents_required.photo_hint: Clear biometric identification

documents_required.name: Trade Self-Declaration
documents_required.photo_hint: Signed statement stating your traditional artisan trade
documents_required.plain_reason: Verifies you practice one of the 18 eligible trades

documents_required.name: Bank Account Details
documents_required.photo_hint: Passbook copy for direct stipend and toolkit grant

physical_office: Common Service Centre (CSC) in your area

name: National Old Age Social Assistance (NSAP)
benefit_description: Monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹2,500 transferred directly to elderly citizens living below poverty line
official_text: The National Social Assistance Programme provides monthly social security pension support to elderly destitute citizens aged 60 and above belonging to BPL households.
simplified_text: A guaranteed monthly pension for senior citizens (age 60 or above) who are in poor families, so they have independent pocket money for medicines and food every single month.

documents_required.name: Age Proof (Aadhaar or Voter ID)
documents_required.photo_hint: Document proving age 60 or above

documents_required.name: BPL Card or Low-Income Certificate
documents_required.photo_hint: Signed by Tahsildar / Revenue Inspector

documents_required.name: Bank / Post Office Passbook
documents_required.photo_hint: First page showing single-holder savings account

physical_office: Taluk / Block Development Office (BDO) or Social Welfare Office

name: Divyangjan Swavalamban Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit_description: Concessional loans up to ₹5 Lakh at 4-6% interest plus free assistive aids and prosthetics
official_text: Provides accessible credit financing and self-employment promotion for persons with 40% or more disability, along with motorized tricycles, braille kits, and hearing aids.
simplified_text: If you or a family member has a physical or sensory disability (40% or more), you can receive free assistive devices (hearing aids, tricycle, braille materials) and low-interest loans to start your own shop or work.

documents_required.name: UDID (Unique Disability ID) or Medical Certificate
documents_required.photo_hint: Hospital certificate showing 40% or greater disability
documents_required.plain_reason: Medical proof required by Department of Empowerment of PwDs

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card
documents_required.photo_hint: Front and back photocopy

documents_required.name: Income Certificate
documents_required.photo_hint: Annual family income certificate

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefit_description: 100% tuition fee waiver plus monthly study allowance of ₹1,500 to ₹3,500 for college education
official_text: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme to provide financial support to SC and ST students studying at post-secondary or college levels to reduce dropouts in higher education.
simplified_text: For SC and ST students who passed 10th class and are studying in 11th, 12th, ITI, diploma, or degree college. It covers college fees and gives monthly allowance for books and living costs.

documents_required.name: Caste Certificate (SC/ST)
documents_required.photo_hint: Official sub-divisional magistrate caste certificate

documents_required.name: 10th Marksheet / Previous Year Result
documents_required.photo_hint: Passing certificate with score card

documents_required.name: College Admission Fee Receipt
documents_required.photo_hint: Valid fee receipt with student roll number

documents_required.name: Family Income Certificate
documents_required.photo_hint: Issued by revenue department within last 6 months
documents_required.plain_reason: Verifies family income is under ₹2.5 Lakh

physical_office: District Social Welfare Office or College Scholarship Clerk

name: Stand-Up India Scheme for Women and SC/ST Entrepreneurs
benefit_description: Bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore for setting up greenfield manufacturing, services, or trading enterprises
official_text: Facilitates bank loans between 10 lakh and 1 crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a new business enterprise.
simplified_text: If you are a woman or from SC/ST category looking to start a new business or small factory, nationalized banks must provide business loans from ₹10 Lakh upwards with government backing.

documents_required.name: Business Project Report
documents_required.photo_hint: Summary of business plan and estimated costs

documents_required.name: Aadhaar and PAN Card
documents_required.photo_hint: Clear individual identity proof

documents_required.name: Caste Certificate (if applying under SC/ST)
documents_required.photo_hint: Revenue certificate

physical_office: Any Scheduled Commercial Bank branch (Lead District Manager)

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefit_description: Free LPG gas connection with stove and first 14.2kg gas cylinder refill completely free of cost
official_text: Provides deposit-free LPG connections to adult women from poor households, including gas regulator, safety pipe, stove, and complimentary first refill.
simplified_text: Gives a free clean cooking gas cylinder and stove in the name of the woman of the house, so you no longer have to cook with smoke-heavy firewood or cow dung cakes.

documents_required.name: Woman's Aadhaar Card
documents_required.photo_hint: Showing full date of birth and address
documents_required.plain_reason: Connection is registered strictly in the woman's name

documents_required.name: Ration Card with family members list
documents_required.photo_hint: Active state ration card
documents_required.plain_reason: Confirms no prior LPG connection exists in household

documents_required.name: Bank Account Details (Aadhaar linked)
documents_required.photo_hint: Bank passbook photocopy
documents_required.plain_reason: Enables future gas cylinder subsidy credits

physical_office: Nearest Indane, Bharatgas, or HP Gas agency

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Crop Loan
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit_description: Short-term agricultural loan up to ₹3 Lakh at an effective low interest rate of just 4% on timely repayment
official_text: Provides adequate and timely credit support from the banking system to farmers for their cultivation and agricultural needs, including post-harvest expenses and maintenance.
simplified_text: A low-interest debit/credit card for farmers to buy fertilizers, seeds, and equipment during crop season. Pay only 4% annual interest if paid on time.

documents_required.name: Land Record (7/12 extract or Patta)
documents_required.photo_hint: Updated revenue extract showing crop sown
documents_required.plain_reason: Determines loan limit based on crop area

documents_required.name: Aadhaar and PAN Card
documents_required.photo_hint: Identification cards

documents_required.name: No-Dues Certificate from local cooperative bank
documents_required.photo_hint: Issued by village primary cooperative society

physical_office: Rural bank or District Central Cooperative Bank branch

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
benefit_description: Paid on-the-job industrial apprenticeship with monthly government stipend support of ₹1,500 (plus company wage)
official_text: Promotes apprenticeship training in industrial establishments by sharing 25% of prescribed stipend subject to a maximum of INR 1,500 per month per apprentice.
simplified_text: For youth looking for jobs or training after school or college. Work inside reputable factories or companies while learning a practical trade and receiving a guaranteed monthly salary.

documents_required.name: Educational Certificate (10th/12th/ITI/Diploma)
documents_required.photo_hint: Final passing certificate
documents_required.plain_reason: Maps you to eligible skill trades

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card
documents_required.photo_hint: Front and back image

documents_required.name: Active Bank Account Passbook
documents_required.photo_hint: First page of account details

physical_office: Government ITI or District Skill Development Office

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefit_description: Maternity cash incentive of ₹5,000 in two installments for pregnant women and lactating mothers for wage compensation and nutrition
official_text: A conditional cash transfer maternity benefit scheme providing partial compensation for wage loss during pregnancy and childbirth so that women can take adequate rest and maintain good nutrition.
simplified_text: Pregnant mothers receive ₹5,000 cash in their bank account to buy healthy food and medicines during their first pregnancy and after the baby's vaccination.

documents_required.name: Mother-Child Protection (MCP) Card
documents_required.photo_hint: Green/pink card issued by Anganwadi or ANM nurse
documents_required.plain_reason: Records prenatal checkups and institutional delivery

documents_required.name: Mother and Husband Aadhaar Cards
documents_required.photo_hint: Clear Aadhaar card images

documents_required.name: Bank Passbook of Mother
documents_required.photo_hint: Single bank account in the mother's name only
documents_required.plain_reason: Government rules require funds to go directly to the mother

physical_office: Your local village Anganwadi Centre (ASHA / AWW worker)

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (MGNREGA)
benefit_description: Legal guarantee of 100 days of wage employment per financial year for adult members of rural households willing to do manual work
official_text: Enhances livelihood security in rural areas by providing at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in every financial year to every household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
simplified_text: If you live in a village and need work, the government guarantees you 100 days of paid work every year near your home (ponds, roads, tree planting) with fixed daily wages transferred to your bank.

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card
documents_required.photo_hint: Clear copy
documents_required.plain_reason: Identity and ABPS wage payment verification

documents_required.name: Passport-sized photograph of all adult family members
documents_required.photo_hint: Standard passport photos

documents_required.name: Bank / Post Office Passbook
documents_required.photo_hint: Account details for weekly wage transfer

physical_office: Gram Panchayat Bhawan / Gram Rozgar Sahayak
deadline: Apply anytime at your Gram Panchayat

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
benefit_description: Government subsidy up to 35% on project cost for setting up new micro-enterprises and small factories
official_text: Credit-linked subsidy programme aimed at generating self-employment opportunities through establishment of micro-enterprises in non-farm sector.
simplified_text: Want to start a small workshop, flour mill, packaging business, or manufacturing unit? The government pays 15% to 35% of the total cost as a non-repayable subsidy, and the bank funds the rest.

documents_required.name: Detailed Project Report (DPR)
documents_required.photo_hint: Summary of machinery, rent, and working capital costs
documents_required.plain_reason: Evaluated by District Task Force Committee

documents_required.name: Educational Qualification Certificate (8th pass or above)
documents_required.photo_hint: School leaving certificate or marksheet

documents_required.name: Special Category Certificate (SC/ST/OBC/Women/Ex-servicemen/PwD)
documents_required.photo_hint: Official issuing authority document
documents_required.plain_reason: Higher subsidy (up to 35% in rural areas)

physical_office: District Industries Centre (DIC) or KVIC State Office
